title: DRIVER TRAINER ASSISTANT FOR CLASS 4 & 6 DRIVERS
industry: Driver, Heavy Equipment, Logistics, Transport and Supply
description:
Lae & POM DRIVER TRAINER ASSISTANT FOR
CLASS 4 & 6 DRIVERS
LOCATION: Lae or Port Moresby
Job Requirements:
Be able to read, write and speak English.
Be a great communicator and have teamwork skills
Have attention to details and be organized
Hold educational diploma or certificate
Have valid Class 4 driver license
Experience and references from reputable employers.
Able to pass medical (including drug & alcohol) test.
Minimum 3-5 years commercial driving experience.
Able to use Microsoft Excel / Word and learn new systems
Knowledge and understanding of PNG Road Code and relevant legislations
Must be of a sober habit
Responsibilities:
Keep daily record/data of training on hard and soft copies
Report to driver trainer manager and fill-in during leave or travel periods
Liasing regularly with other departments and managers
Assist in Training and Assessing Drivers based on the company policies
Assist in organizational preparations for training
Assist in Training and preparations for drivers Assessments
Assist in Inducting drivers on daily operational activities and documentations
Share and communicate toolbox talks to drivers
Priorotise work and follow up on any concerns and issues
Good rates awaits the successful candidate plus overtime.
Please apply in writing to below email or hand deliver to the main office Malaita Street:
[email protected]
**DO NOT APPLY IF YOUR SKILLS DO NOT FIT ABOVE REQUIREMENTS. THOSE APPLICATIONS WILL NOT BE ATTENDED AND APPLICANT WILL NOT GET ANY REPLY.
